name: vampires and garlic
source:
Ameline, a vampire, has dinner with Clara, a human. And it escalates from there.

[From [url=https://catellion.itch.io/vampires-and-garlic]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
吸血鬼阿梅琳和人類克拉拉一起吃晚飯。從這頓飯開始，事情就越來越不得了。
